arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Goldstein argued the word jurisdiction has many meanings in different contexts.
Goldstein cited seventeen cases where the Court reviewed entry point questions de novo.
Verrilli argued the side that brought the case's central point cuts through most arguments.
Ginsburg noted the Commission has broad rule-making power to carry out the Act.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The City of Arlington challenges the FCC's interpretation of a statute. The agency claims this interpretation defines its legal authority. The city argues courts must review this question independently.

paragraphs: This case defines the boundary between agency power and judicial review. It determines how courts treat an agency's claim of legal authority. The outcome shapes the balance of power in administrative law.
